definitions.short: a marine or land monster , i.e. sea-serpent or jackal
definitions.full: H8577. tannin תַּנִּין (erroneous תַּנִּים ) noun masculine Ezek 29:3 serpent, dragon, sea-monster (Late Hebrew id. (rare); Arabic , loan-word from Aramaic תַּנִּינָא , Frä 123 ; Ethiopic ); — absolute ׳ת Exod 7:9 +, יִ֯ם Ezek 29:3 ; 32:2 (by confusion with plural of [ תַּן ]); plural תַּנִּינַם Gen 1:21 , etc.; — 1 serpent , Deut 32:33 (venomous), Psa 91:13 (|| מֶּתֶן ), Exod 7:9-10 , 12 (P). 2 dragon , as devourer (simile) Jer 51:34 ; הַתּ ׳עֵין Neh 2:13 , near Jerusalem 3 sea - (or river-) monster , Gen 1:21 (P); figurative Job 7:12 ; Psa 74:13 (i.e. Egyptains), Isa 27:1 ; 51:9 (|| רַהַב , mythological personification of chaos); in summons to praise ׳י Psa 148:7 (|| תְּהֹמוֺת ). — See Che Ency. occurrences.englishText: God created the large sea creatures and every living creature that moves, with which the waters swarmed, after their kind, and every winged bird after its kind. God saw that it was good.
“When Pharaoh speaks to you, saying, ‘Perform a miracle!’ then you shall tell Aaron, ‘Take your rod, and cast it down before Pharaoh, and it will become a serpent.’ ”
Moses and Aaron went in to Pharaoh, and they did so, as Yahweh had commanded. Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh and before his servants, and it became a serpent.
For they each cast down their rods, and they became serpents; but Aaron’s rod swallowed up their rods.
Their wine is the poison of serpents,
I went out by night by the valley gate, even toward the jackal’s well, then to the dung gate, and inspected the walls of Jerusalem, which were broken down, and its gates were consumed with fire.
Am I a sea, or a sea monster,
I am a brother to jackals,
If we have forgotten the name of our God,
You divided the sea by your strength.
You will tread on the lion and cobra.
Praise Yahweh from the earth,
Wolves will cry in their fortresses, and jackals in the pleasant palaces. Her time is near to come, and her days will not be prolonged.
In that day, Yahweh with his hard and great and strong sword will punish leviathan, the fleeing serpent, and leviathan the twisted serpent; and he will kill the dragon that is in the sea.
Thorns will come up in its palaces,
The burning sand will become a pool,
The animals of the field, the jackals and the ostriches, shall honor me,
Awake, awake, put on strength, arm of Yahweh!
I will weep and wail for the mountains,
The voice of news, behold, it comes,
The wild donkeys stand on the bare heights.
Hazor will be a dwelling place of jackals,
“Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon has devoured me.
Babylon will become heaps,
Speak and say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says:
For this I will lament and wail;
